title: Transcriptome analysis of the effects of melanocortin analogues, as well as Selank and PGP in SH-SY5Y cells at 22h after oxidative stress
description:
Introduction. Oxidative stress is an important pathogenetic mechanism of stroke, other neurodegenerative diseases, and is also involved in cellular aging. Here, we study the effects of the peptides MEHFPGP (ACTH(4-7)PGP, Semax), HFRWPGP (ACTH(6-9)PGP), and TKPRPGP (Selank) on the transcriptome of SH-SY5Y cells at 22 h after oxidative stress.

Overall design. Cells SH-SY5Y were exposed to hydrogen peroxide at a final concentration of 40 mcM for 20 min, then hydrogen peroxide was removed and fresh medium containing Semax, ACTH(6-9)PGP, Selank or PGP at a final concentration 1 mM were applied for 22 h. Control samples were exposed to medium without hydrogen peroxide adding or incubated after hydrogen peroxide exposure with fresh medium containing equal volume of peptide diluent (phosphate buffered saline). All experiments were performed in triplicates.

Growth protocol. SH-SY5Y cells were cultured under standard conditions in DMEM/F12 medium (Paneco, Russia) containing 10% fetal bovine serum, 2 mM alanyl glutamine, 40 mcg per ml gentamicin in a CO2 incubator at 37C and 5 percents CO2 to 70-80 percents confluence. A day before treatments 10 million cells were seeded into T25 culture flasks.

Treatment protocol. For the treatments growth medium was removed, cells were washed twice with DPBS and serum-free DMEM medium containing 40 mcM hydrogen peroxide was added and cells were incubated in CO2-incubator for 20 min. Then, the medium with H2O2 was removed, cells were rinsed with serum-free DMEM F12 medium and fresh serum-free DMEM F12 medium containing 1 mM peptide was added and cells were incubated for 22 h.

Transcriptome analysis. Total RNA was extracted using TRI-reagent (MRC Inc., USA). Genome-wide transcriptome analysis of mRNA level in SH-SY5Y cells was carried out using high-throughput RNA-sequencing (RNA-Seq). Sequencing was carried out using an Illumina NextSeq2000 instrument. At least 10 million reads (1/50 nt) were generated.
